title: Yuki's Dojo Arena
description: A refined space for honorable combat. Prove your skill in the art of battle.
canvas_arena_overview_description: In this hall, warriors demonstrate their skill and honor through combat. Each match brings wisdom.

canvas_arena_subrole_descriptions.duelo: A single duel. Two warriors testing their skills. The result is recorded in the dojo scrolls.
canvas_arena_subrole_descriptions.coliseo: Multiple warriors in honorable chaos. Minimum four. The last standing earns recognition.
canvas_arena_subrole_descriptions.torneo: Structured tournament. Minimum eight. Brackets like the paths of ancient masters.

duelo.title: The Single Duel
duelo.description: Invite another warrior to a match of skill. The result is written in the dojo records.
duelo.select_opponent: Select the warrior you wish to challenge:
duelo.challenge_sent: The invitation has been sent. Awaiting your opponent's response.
duelo.challenge_received_desc: has challenged you to a duel in the Arena.
duelo.declined: The challenge has been declined. Not all paths lead to combat.
duelo.no_weapons: You have no weapons yet. Participate in matches to acquire them.

coliseo.title: The Coliseum - Multi-Warrior Combat
coliseo.description: Minimum four participants. The last standing earns one experience point.
coliseo.not_enough: Insufficient warriors. Four are required for the match.
coliseo.cancelled: The coliseum has been cancelled. Not all warriors found their path.

torneo.title: The Tournament - Path of Champions
torneo.description: Minimum eight participants. Elimination brackets. One experience point for the final warrior.
torneo.not_enough: Insufficient warriors. Eight are necessary for the brackets.
torneo.cancelled: The tournament has been cancelled. Some matches do not find their beginning.

ranking.title: Warrior Honor Roll
ranking.no_fighters: No warriors registered yet. The dojo awaits its first match.

weapons.title: Armory
weapons.description: Weapons unlocked through your journey in combat.

errors.no_channel: Could not create the Arena channel. Please verify permissions.
errors.role_disabled: The Arena module is not active in this hall.
errors.already_registered: You are already registered for this event.
errors.not_registered: You are not registered for this event.
errors.event_in_progress: A match is in progress. Please wait for it to conclude.
errors.self_challenge: You cannot challenge yourself. The path of combat requires another.
